name: lets-contribute
description: Let's Contribute — a glassmorphic home for open-source opportunities, ideas and project discussions. NestJS + Next.js + Neon, deployed on Vercel.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lets-contribute/api && npm run build --workspace @lets-contribute/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @lets-contribute/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @lets-contribute/web
